newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC says job cuts won't hit output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC says job cuts won't hit output.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Tuesday that full year production from its Kambalda nickel/gold operations in Western Australia would not be affected by a decision announced earlier in the day to cut 445 jobs.

WMC said earlier it was cutting the jobs in favour of using specialist mining contractors to improve the efficiency of the operation. "Although production may be affected in this first half year, there is not expected to be a significant impact on production for the full year," WMC said in a statement.
Kambalda produced 37,460 tonnes of nickel contained in concentrate in 1995/96 to June 30, a 10 percent increase on the previous 12 months, WMC figures show.
